latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of fridge-keeper.

- Manage food items in and out of your fridge with expiry tracking.
- Supports entry, removal, and querying of food items.
- Provides expiry alerts and reminders based on custom settings.
- Recommends recipes using available and soon-to-expire ingredients.
- Offers both local file and remote database storage options.
